messages:
alex: heads up — we're starting to wire up the new runtime / infra inputs into the console dashboards next sprint. want to align on a metrics schema before we emit a ton of high-cardinality labels. can we quick-sync here?

maya: +1. runtime currently emits: service, env, region, model_id, model_variant, seq_len_bucket, route, batch_size. model_id is going to blow up cardinality if we keep it on high-volume counters. :grimacing:

sam: infra perspective: the metric shipper also tags by host and container_id. those are noisy — we should only surface them to SRE dashboards, not product dashboards. relabeling at scrape/ingest will be necessary.

jordan: from console UX — we need consistent filterable labels for dashboards and rollouts UX: product wants model_family, model_variant, deployment_tag (canary/primary), region, and route. we don't need raw container ids exposed in dropdowns.

maya: suggested runtime label set to emit by default: service, env, region, model_family, model_variant, quant, route, deployment_tag. keep model_id only in a low-frequency trace or sampled counter.

alex: sounds reasonable. quick Q: model_family vs model_variant naming convention? lower_snake_case or dot-separated? need to be consistent across telemetry and the console.

tess: recommend kebab-case for human-facing labels (e.g., "gpt-3-small" -> gpt-3-small) and snake_case for prometheus metric names. label key naming: use consistent prefixes where helpful: rwi_ is overkill. keep label keys short: model_family, model_variant, deployment_tag.

sam: ops-bot: run a cardinality check on existing counters for past 30d.

ops-bot: running cardinality scan: metric_count=1123, unique_label_combinations=1,240,567, top_contributor label=model_id (~68% of unique combos). ETA ~ 30s.

ops-bot: cardinality scan complete. notes: model_id and container_id are the dominant sources of cardinality. region and route are low-cardinality.

maya: proposal: emit model_family and model_variant; drop model_id from counters. If teams need model_id they can opt into a sampled metric or attach to traces. We'll add an attribution sampling flag in runtime config.

jordan: for dashboards I'll wire up canonical label names: model_family, model_variant, deployment_tag, region, route. Those will be the only model-related filters in the UI. Any other fields go into an "advanced" section (hidden by default).

alex: actionable items: 1) runtime: change default emitted labels (maya) 2) infra: add relabel_configs to drop container_id/model_id from product metrics (sam) 3) observability: run automated cardinality tests and add gating for PRs that add new labels (tess) 4) console: map UI filters to canonical labels (jordan)

maya: I'll submit a PR with a small RFC in runtime repo outlining the new label set + sampling opt-in. target: RCF + impl by next Tue (1758840000)

sam: I'll add a relabel rule snippet for Prometheus config. Suggestions?

maya: something like:```yaml
# in prometheus relabel_configs
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model_id]
  target_label: model_id
  action: replace
- regex: ".+"
  source_labels: [model_id]
  action: drop
  # keep model_id only for metrics with label: keep_model_id="true"
```
(note: this is illustrative — we should use metric_relabel_configs to be precise)

sam: +1, I'll convert to metric_relabel_configs and scope to product metrics. also will add a small mapping to translate model_id -> model_family via a lookup table where feasible (in the shipper).

tess: I'll add a test to the observability repo that fails CI if any new default counter introduces >10k new unique label values in a 7d sample. also, let's add lint rules: label_key naming regex ^[a-z0-9_]+$ and disallow uppercase/dots.

jordan: for rollouts UX we also need deployment_tag values: canary/primary/experiment. please ensure runtime sets deployment_tag exactly to one of those or empty, not freeform.

maya: agreed. we'll add an enum in config and default to empty for old deployments.

alex: decision summary for posterity: canonical label keys: model_family, model_variant, deployment_tag, env, region, route, quant, batch_size (batch_size allowed but warn on cardinality). Drop model_id and container_id from product-facing counters; allow sampled metrics/traces for identity. Add CI cardinality gate and label naming lint.

sam: timeline: I'll push relabel configs to staging prometheus by EOD Friday (1758790000).

maya: I'll open the runtime RFC PR today and tag @tess for the lint + tests.

tess: will draft CI check and a short docs page for "label hygiene".

alex: awesome. let's close this thread once the RFC PR is merged. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder set: check-in 1758850000
